module_summary: AXI-Lite to AXI-Stream bridge: skid-buffered AXI-Lite writes push words into a source FIFO driving M_AXIS, reads pop a sink FIFO fed by S_AXIS or return stats/fill registers, with timeouts producing bus errors.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: Accepts AW+W pair when response free and FIFO not full or timed out; triggers BVALID and FIFO write.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: Accepts read address when response free and sink data present or timed out; loads read data.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Stream master valid, asserted when source FIFO not empty.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Stream output data read from source FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Stream slave valid; with TREADY writes data into sink FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read data from registered mux of sink data, stats and FIFO fill.

anchors.name: arskd_addr
anchors.why: Skid-buffered read word address selecting sink, stats or FIFO register.

anchors.name: wfifo_write
anchors.why: Write enable of source FIFO on accepted write to source address.

anchors.name: read_rfifo
anchors.why: Pops sink FIFO on accepted read of sink address.

anchors.name: wfifo_full
anchors.why: Source FIFO full stalls writes, starts write timeout and sets BRESP error.

anchors.name: rfifo_empty
anchors.why: Sink FIFO empty stalls reads, starts read timeout and sets RRESP error.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write response valid; back-pressures write acceptance.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read response valid; back-pressures read acceptance.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Skid-buffered write word address; source address selects FIFO write and TLAST bit.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Stream input data written with TLAST into sink FIFO.

anchors.name: wskd_data
anchors.why: Skid-buffered write data whose low bits enter source FIFO.

anchors.name: awskd_valid
anchors.why: Write address skid buffer output valid.

anchors.name: wskd_valid
anchors.why: Write data skid buffer output valid.

anchors.name: arskd_valid
anchors.why: Read address skid buffer output valid.

anchors.name: axil_berr
anchors.why: Write error flag driving BRESP when source FIFO full.

anchors.name: axil_rerr
anchors.why: Read error flag driving RRESP when sink FIFO empty.

anchors.name: GEN_WRITE_TIMEOUT.write_timer
anchors.why: Counts down stalled cycles while source FIFO full.

anchors.name: GEN_WRITE_TIMEOUT.r_write_timeout
anchors.why: Write timeout expired; forces write acceptance with error.

anchors.name: GEN_READ_TIMEOUT.read_timer
anchors.why: Counts down stalled cycles while sink FIFO empty.

anchors.name: GEN_READ_TIMEOUT.r_read_timeout
anchors.why: Read timeout expired; forces read acceptance with error.

anchors.name: reads_completed
anchors.why: Counts sink words read; reported in stats register.

anchors.name: read_bursts_completed
anchors.why: Counts sink packets (TLAST) read; reported in stats register.

anchors.name: GEN_WRITES_COMPLETED.r_writes_completed
anchors.why: Counts words sent on M_AXIS for stats register.

anchors.name: GEN_WRITES_COMPLETED.r_write_bursts_completed
anchors.why: Counts M_AXIS packets (TLAST) for stats register.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: Stream last flag from source FIFO, set by address bit.

anchors.name: rfifo_data
anchors.why: Sink FIFO output data, optionally sign-extended into read data.

anchors.name: rfifo_last
anchors.why: Sink FIFO head TLAST, counted and reported in FIFO register.

groups.name: axil_write_path
groups.description: Skid-buffered AW/W acceptance, write response and error generation.

groups.name: write_timeout
groups.description: Times out writes stalled on a full source FIFO.

groups.name: source_fifo
groups.description: FIFO from AXI-Lite writes to the M_AXIS stream.

groups.name: sink_fifo
groups.description: FIFO from S_AXIS stream to AXI-Lite reads.

groups.name: axil_read_path
groups.description: Skid-buffered read acceptance and registered read data mux.

groups.name: read_timeout
groups.description: Times out reads stalled on an empty sink FIFO.

groups.name: stats_counters
groups.description: Word and packet counters for both stream directions.
